# Research Brief — rame-studio **Project:** rame-studio — Web Design & SEO Studio Platform **Stack:** .NET 10 Clean Architecture backend + React 19 + Vite + TypeScript frontend **Status:** done **Last updated:** 2026-10-27 **Research topic:** Glassmorphism design system patterns, libraries, and best practices for UI redesign --- ## 5-Bullet Summary - **Glassmorphism core technique:** a translucent fill (`bg-white/60` or `bg-slate-900/60`), `backdrop-filter: blur()` (Tailwind v4 `backdrop-blur-*` scale: xs 4px → 3xl 64px), a 1px light border (`border-white/20`), and optional `backdrop-saturate-150` to offset graying. Tailwind v4 emits both `backdrop-filter` and `-webkit-backdrop-filter` automatically; `bg-*` opacity compiles to `color-mix()`. - **Compatibility with Antigravity UI + Tailwind CSS 4:** Antigravity UI is a Tailwind-based component system (utility-first, no hard-coded opaque fills), so glass utilities compose directly on its components. Tailwind v4's `supports-[backdrop-filter]:` variant provides solid-fill fallbacks for browsers without `backdrop-filter`; avoid nesting glass inside glass (inner panel can only blur the outer panel's contents). - **Accessibility:** check contrast over the *effective* surface color (not just the fill) — a 60% white fill over violet can yield ~4.0:1, failing 4.5:1 for body text; use darker text or raise opacity. Support `prefers-reduced-transparency` (custom Tailwind variant) and `prefers-contrast: more` (`contrast-more:` variant); add `scroll-padding-top` for sticky glass headers so focused elements stay visible; never animate `backdrop-filter` radius itself. - **Performance:** `backdrop-filter` recomputes whenever content behind the panel changes (scrolling under sticky headers). One header/card is fine; many glass panels, very large panels, or animating blur radius cause jank on low-end phones. Reduce glass surface count before reducing blur radius; avoid `backdrop-filter`/`opacity` on `` or page wrappers (blocks child blur). - **Recommended stack:** Tailwind CSS 4 (native `backdrop-blur-*`, `supports-[backdrop-filter]:`, `color-mix()` opacity) + Antigravity UI components + custom `glass` design tokens in `tailwind.config.js`/CSS variables + React 19 components with `prefers-reduced-transparency`/`prefers-reduced-motion` guards + optional `@yhooi2/shadcn-glass-ui` for pre-built glass primitives. --- ## Glassmorphism CSS Techniques ### Core glass surface recipe (Tailwind v4) ```tsx
{/* content */}
``` | Part | Utility | Purpose | |------|---------|---------| | Translucent fill | `bg-white/60` (or `bg-slate-900/60`) | Lets background show through; opacity drives readability | | Backdrop blur | `backdrop-blur-lg` (16px) / arbitrary `backdrop-blur-[20px]` | Frosted effect; Tailwind v4 scale xs→3xl | | Saturation boost | `backdrop-saturate-150` | Offsets gray cast from light fills | | Edge | `border border-white/20` | Separates panel where blur alone doesn't | | Shadow | `shadow-lg` | Depth separation | ### Fallback for browsers without `backdrop-filter` ```tsx
{/* content */}
``` Solid fill first; translucency only where `backdrop-filter` is supported. Tailwind v4's `supports-[backdrop-filter]:` variant generates the `@supports` block automatically. ### Sticky glass header ```tsx
{/* nav */}
``` Keep fill high (75%+) since header text sits over whatever scrolls past. Add `scroll-padding-top` to `html` equal to header height so keyboard focus stays visible. --- ## Recommended Stack | Layer | Choice | Rationale | |-------|--------|-----------| | Styling | Tailwind CSS 4 | Native `backdrop-blur-*`, `supports-[backdrop-filter]:`, `color-mix()` opacity, no custom CSS needed | | Component library | Antigravity UI | Tailwind-based, utility-first, no opaque hard-coded fills — glass utilities compose directly | | Glass primitives (optional) | `@yhooi2/shadcn-glass-ui` | Pre-built glass (dark/light) themes if pre-made components preferred | | Design tokens | CSS variables + `tailwind.config.js` | Centralize blur radius, fill opacity, border opacity for theming | | Accessibility guards | `prefers-reduced-transparency` (custom variant), `contrast-more:`, `prefers-reduced-motion` | Respect user motion/transparency/contrast preferences | --- ## Glassmorphism Implementation Approach 1. **Define glass tokens** — blur radius (md/lg/xl), fill opacity (60–80%), border opacity (10–20%) as CSS variables consumed by Tailwind. 2. **Build a `` / `` React component** wrapping the core recipe, with `supports-[backdrop-filter]:` fallback. 3. **Apply glass selectively** — headers, modals, cards, sidebars; avoid full-page backgrounds and nesting glass inside glass. 4. **Contrast-test over real backdrops** — check text contrast over the effective surface color across light/dark and image backdrops; adjust fill opacity or text color. 5. **Add accessibility variants** — `reduce-transparency:bg-white reduce-transparency:backdrop-blur-none`, `contrast-more:` for higher contrast. 6. **Performance guardrails** — limit concurrent glass surfaces, avoid animating blur radius, don't put `backdrop-filter`/`opacity` on `` or wrappers. --- ## Compatibility Notes: Antigravity UI + Tailwind CSS 4 - **Antigravity UI** is a Tailwind-first component system; its components accept `className` overrides, so `backdrop-blur-*`, `bg-*/opacity`, and `border-*/opacity` utilities compose directly without fighting component styles. - **Tailwind CSS 4** compiles `bg-white/60` to `color-mix()` and emits both `backdrop-filter` and `-webkit-backdrop-filter` for every `backdrop-*` utility — no manual vendor prefixes needed. - **`supports-[backdrop-filter]:`** variant provides progressive enhancement: solid fill on unsupported browsers, glass on supported ones. - **Avoid nesting glass inside glass** — the inner panel can only blur the outer panel's contents, not the page behind. - **Don't apply `opacity`/`filter`/`backdrop-filter` on `` or page wrappers** — these create a backdrop root that blocks child panels from blurring page content. --- ## Accessibility Considerations - **Contrast:** verify text contrast against the *effective* surface color (fill blended with backdrop), not the fill alone. A 60% white fill over violet can measure ~4.0:1 (fails 4.5:1 body minimum); use darker text or raise opacity to 75–80%. - **`prefers-reduced-transparency`:** add a custom Tailwind variant (`@custom-variant reduce-transparency (@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce))`) and switch to solid fill + `backdrop-blur-none`. - **`prefers-contrast: more`:** use Tailwind's `contrast-more:` variant to increase fill opacity / border contrast. - **`prefers-reduced-motion`:** disable backdrop animations; don't animate `backdrop-filter` radius. - **Sticky headers:** add `scroll-padding-top` to `html` so focused elements don't hide behind the glass header. - **Focus indicators:** ensure focus-visible rings remain visible over translucent surfaces. --- ## Performance Implications - `backdrop-filter` recomputes whenever content behind the panel changes (e.g., page scrolling under a sticky header). - One header or card is normally fine; problems appear with many glass panels on screen, very large panels, or animating blur radius. - On low-end phones, reduce the number of glass surfaces before reducing blur radius. - Never apply `backdrop-filter` or `opacity` to `` or page wrappers — it blocks child blur and forces full-page recompositing. --- ## Sources - GradientDeck, "Glassmorphism in Tailwind CSS v4: blur, fallbacks, and readable text" — https://gradientdeck.com/blog/glassmorphism-in-tailwind-css-v4 - OpenReplay, "Creating Blurred Backgrounds Using CSS Backdrop-Filter" — https://blog.openreplay.com/creating-blurred-backgrounds-css-backdrop-filter/ - UXPilot, "12 Glassmorphism UI Features, Best Practices, and Examples" — https://uxpilot.ai/blogs/glassmorphism-ui - Antigravity UI Skill (UI Styling) — https://www.antigravityskills.org/skill/ui-styling - @yhooi2/shadcn-glass-ui (npm) — https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yhooi2/shadcn-glass-ui

# References — Rame Studio Glassmorphism Design System

**Product:** Rame Studio — Web Design & SEO Studio Platform (dashboard + public site)
**Vibe:** Premium, modern, frosted glass, semi-transparent surfaces, subtle borders, light/dark mode, RTL (fa) + LTR (en)
**Status:** done
**Date:** 2026-10-27

---

## 1. Reference URLs (with screenshots)

| # | URL | Type | Screenshots |
|---|-----|------|-------------|
| 1 | https://liquidglassdesign.com/gallery/glassmorphism-dashboard-ui-design | Glassmorphism dashboard gallery | `images/01-liquidglass-dashboard-1440.png`, `images/01-liquidglass-dashboard-390.png` |
| 2 | https://superdesign.dev/styles/glassmorphism/dashboard | Glassmorphism dashboard design & examples | `images/02-superdesign-dashboard-1440.png`, `images/02-superdesign-dashboard-390.png` |
| 3 | https://uxpilot.ai/blogs/glassmorphism-ui | Glassmorphism UI features, best practices & examples | `images/03-uxpilot-glassmorphism-1440.png` |
| 4 | https://www.shadcn.io/blocks/navbar-glassmorphism | shadcn glassmorphism navbar block (React + Tailwind) | `images/04-shadcn-navbar-1440.png` |
| 5 | https://allshadcn.com/components/glass-ui/ | All Shadcn Glass UI component collection | `images/05-allshadcn-glass-ui-1440.png`, `images/05-allshadcn-glass-ui-390.png` |
| 6 | https://tailwindflex.com/@jugendra-gangwar/premium-ai-startup-glassmorphism-navbar | Premium AI startup glassmorphism navbar | (search result only) |

---

## 2. Extracted Color Palette (Glassmorphism)

### Light Mode (frosted glass over light bg)
| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--glass-bg` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)` | Card/surface base |
| `--glass-border` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)` | Subtle borders (1px) |
| `--glass-shadow` | `0 8px 32px 0 rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.15)` | Backdrop shadow |
| `--glass-highlight` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)` | Top/left edge highlight |
| `--primary` | `#6366f1` (Indigo-500) | Primary actions |
| `--primary-hover` | `#4f46e5` (Indigo-600) | Primary hover |
| `--surface` | `#f8fafc` (Slate-50) | Page background |
| `--text-primary` | `#0f172a` (Slate-900) | Body text |
| `--text-secondary` | `#64748b` (Slate-500) | Muted text |

### Dark Mode (frosted glass over dark bg)
| Token | Hex | Usage |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `--glass-bg` | `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)` | Card/surface base |
| `--glass-border` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)` | Subtle borders |
| `--glass-shadow` | `0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)` | Backdrop shadow |
| `--glass-highlight` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` | Top/left edge highlight |
| `--primary` | `#818cf8` (Indigo-400) | Primary actions |
| `--primary-hover` | `#6366f1` (Indigo-500) | Primary hover |
| `--surface` | `#0f172a` (Slate-900) | Page background |
| `--text-primary` | `#f8fafc` (Slate-50) | Body text |
| `--text-secondary` | `#94a3b8` (Slate-400) | Muted text |

### Glass CSS (copy-ready)
```css
.glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(180%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.15);
}
.glass-dark {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}
```

---

## 3. Typography

| Scale | Size | Weight | Usage |
|-------|------|--------|-------|
| h1 | 1.875rem (30px) | 700 | Page titles |
| h2 | 1.5rem (24px) | 600 | Section headings |
| h3 | 1.25rem (20px) | 600 | Card titles |
| body | 1rem (16px) | 400 | Body text |
| small | 0.875rem (14px) | 400 | Captions, labels |
| xs | 0.75rem (12px) | 500 | Badges, tags |

**Font family:** Inter (system-ui fallback), with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` for data. RTL (fa) uses Vazirmatn / Iran Sans as fallback.

**Line height:** 1.5 body, 1.2 headings. **Letter tracking:** -0.02em headings, 0 body.

---

## 4. Layout Patterns

### Dashboard shell
- **Top navbar:** glassmorphism, fixed height 64px, sticky, z-50, blur bg, subtle bottom border.
- **Sidebar:** glassmorphism, fixed width 260px (collapsible to 72px), sticky, left-aligned LTR / right-aligned RTL.
- **Main content:** padded container, max-width 1440px, centered, scrollable.
- **Cards:** glassmorphism, rounded-xl (12px), hover lift (translate-y -2px), subtle border.
- **Grid:** responsive 12-col Tailwind grid, gap-6 (24px), breakpoints sm/md/lg/xl.

### RTL (fa) adaptations
- `direction: rtl` on `<html dir="rtl">`; sidebar on right; navbar end-aligned; margins/padding mirrored via `ml`/`mr` logical properties; form labels right-aligned; dropdowns open left.

---

## 5. Component List (glassmorphism variants)

| Component | Glassmorphism spec | Antigravity UI compat |
|-----------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Navbar | Glass bg, blur, bottom border, logo left, nav links right, user avatar far right | ✅ shadcn navbar block |
| Sidebar | Glass bg, blur, nav items with hover state, collapse toggle | ✅ shadcn sidebar pattern |
| Card | Glass bg, 1px border, rounded-xl, hover shadow increase | ✅ existing card.tsx |
| Button | Glass bg on ghost, solid on primary, rounded-lg, transition all | ✅ existing button.tsx |
| Input | Glass bg, subtle border, focus ring brand color, rounded-lg | ✅ existing input.tsx |
| Modal/Dialog | Glass backdrop (blur), glass panel, rounded-2xl, overlay dim | ⬜ needs dialog.tsx |
| Badge | Glass bg, rounded-full, px-2 py-0.5, text-xs | ✅ shadcn badge |
| Table | Glass header row, zebra rows subtle, rounded-xl container | ⬜ needs table |
| Dropdown | Glass menu, blur, border, shadow-lg, rounded-lg | ⬜ needs dropdown |
| Toast | Glass container, slide-in, rounded-lg, auto-dismiss | ⬜ needs toast |
| Avatar | Glass ring, rounded-full, border highlight | ✅ shadcn avatar |
| Switch | Glass track, colored thumb, rounded-full | ✅ shadcn switch |
| Tabs | Glass underline indicator, rounded-lg active | ✅ shadcn tabs |

---

## 6. Compatibility with Antigravity UI

**Antigravity UI** (shadcn/ui-based, Tailwind, Radix primitives) is fully compatible:

- **shadcn navbar-glassmorphism block** (reference #4) drops directly into the existing `components/ui/` structure — same Tailwind classes, same `cn()` utility, same Radix primitives.
- **All Shadcn Glass UI** (reference #5) provides glass variants of button, input, card, dialog, dropdown — all built on shadcn/ui, matching the project's existing `button.tsx`, `input.tsx`, `card.tsx`.
- **Tailwind + Radix** stack: Antigravity UI uses Tailwind CSS + Radix UI, identical to rame-studio frontend. No framework migration needed.
- **CSS variables:** Antigravity uses CSS custom properties for theming; rame-studio can extend the same pattern for light/dark + glass tokens.
- **RTL:** Antigravity supports `dir="rtl"` via logical properties; rame-studio already needs RTL (fa) support.

**Recommended integration path:**
1. Add glass CSS variables to `globals.css` (light/dark).
2. Create `components/ui/dialog.tsx` (glass modal) using Radix Dialog.
3. Update `button.tsx`, `input.tsx`, `card.tsx` with glass variants (`variant="glass"`).
4. Add `components/ui/navbar.tsx` (glass) based on shadcn navbar-glassmorphism block.
5. Add `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` (glass, collapsible, RTL-aware).
6. Verify with `npm run build` and visual QA at 1440px and 390px.

---

## 7. Verification

- **5+ reference URLs:** ✅ 6 URLs captured (Liquid Glass, Superdesign, UXPilot, shadcn, All Shadcn, TailwindFlex).
- **Screenshots at 1440px and 390px:** ✅ 8 screenshots saved in `docs/references/images/`.
- **Extracted palette:** ✅ light + dark glass tokens with hex/rgba values.
- **Typography:** ✅ scale, weights, line heights, RTL font fallback.
- **Layout patterns:** ✅ navbar/sidebar/card/grid + RTL adaptations.
- **Component list:** ✅ 12 components with glassmorphism specs and Antigravity compat flags.
- **Antigravity UI compatibility:** ✅ confirmed (same Tailwind + Radix + shadcn stack).

- **RTL:** Antigravity supports `dir="rtl"` via logical properties; rame-studio already needs RTL (fa) support.

**Recommended integration path:**
1. Add glass CSS variables to `globals.css` (light/dark).
2. Create `components/ui/dialog.tsx` (glass modal) using Radix Dialog.
3. Update `button.tsx`, `input.tsx`, `card.tsx` with glass variants (`variant="glass"`).
4. Add `components/ui/navbar.tsx` (glass) based on shadcn navbar-glassmorphism block.
5. Add `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` (glass, collapsible, RTL-aware).
6. Verify with `npm run build` and visual QA at 1440px and 390px.

---

## 7. Verification

- **5+ reference URLs:** ✅ 6 URLs captured (Liquid Glass, Superdesign, UXPilot, shadcn, All Shadcn, TailwindFlex).

# Design System — Rame Studio (Glassmorphism Redesign)

**Project:** rame-studio
**Date:** 2026-10-27
**Phase:** Redesign — Glassmorphism UI + Backend rebuild
**Status:** 🔵 design (in progress)
**Frontend:** React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS 4.x + Antigravity UI + shadcn/ui primitives
**Backend:** .NET 10 + Clean Architecture ASP.NET Core 10 Web API (full redesign)

---

## 1. Design Philosophy — Glassmorphism

Rame Studio is a web design and SEO studio. The entire UI (public site + admin/customer/team dashboards) is redesigned with **glassmorphism**: frosted-glass surfaces, backdrop blur, semi-transparent layers, thin hairline borders, and subtle depth. The design feels premium, light, and modern while remaining fully functional.

**Core glassmorphism principles applied:**
- `backdrop-filter: blur(12px–20px)` on all glass surfaces
- Semi-transparent backgrounds: `rgba(255,255,255,0.1–0.3)` light / `rgba(0,0,0,0.2–0.4)` dark
- 1px hairline borders: `rgba(255,255,255,0.1–0.2)` on edges
- Soft drop shadows for depth under glass panels
- Gradient mesh backgrounds behind glass to make blur visible
- Layered stacking: background → gradient mesh → glass cards → content

**Bilingual:** Persian (fa) is the default locale and is RTL. English (en) is LTR. The `dir` attribute on `<html>` switches accordingly. All layout, spacing, and text alignment must mirror for RTL. Sidebar stays on the left in both directions.

---

## 2. Glass Colour Palette

### Light mode glass tokens

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--glass-bg` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)` | Main glass surface |
| `--glass-bg-hover` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78)` | Glass hover state |
| `--glass-border` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)` | Glass hairline border |
| `--glass-border-hover` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)` | Focused glass border |
| `--glass-shadow` | `0 8px 32px 0 rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.15)` | Glass elevation |
| `--glass-shadow-lg` | `0 20px 40px 0 rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.22)` | Modal/dropdown glass |
| `--background` | `#f8fafc` (slate-50) | Page body (gradient mesh base) |
| `--surface` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)` | Cards, panels, modals |
| `--text-primary` | `#0f172a` (slate-900) | Headings, primary labels |
| `--text-secondary` | `#475569` (slate-600) | Metadata, captions |
| `--text-muted` | `#94a3b8` (slate-400) | Disabled text, placeholders |
| `--primary` | `#4f46e5` (indigo-600) | Primary buttons, links |
| `--primary-hover` | `#4338ca` (indigo-700) | Primary button hover |
| `--primary-text` | `#ffffff` | Text on primary buttons |
| `--accent` | `#0ea5e9` (sky-500) | Accent highlights |
| `--success` | `#22c55e` (green-500) | Success states |
| `--warning` | `#f59e0b` (amber-500) | Warning states |
| `--error` | `#ef4444` (red-500) | Error states |
| `--info` | `#3b82f6` (blue-500) | Informational states |

### Dark mode glass tokens

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--glass-bg` | `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75)` | Main glass surface |
| `--glass-bg-hover` | `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)` | Glass hover state |
| `--glass-border` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)` | Glass hairline border |
| `--glass-border-hover` | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)` | Focused glass border |
| `--glass-shadow` | `0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)` | Glass elevation |
| `--glass-shadow-lg` | `0 20px 40px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)` | Modal/dropdown glass |
| `--background` | `#0f172a` (slate-900) | Page body (gradient mesh base) |
| `--surface` | `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8)` | Cards, panels, modals |
| `--text-primary` | `#f8fafc` (slate-50) | Headings, primary labels |
| `--text-secondary` | `#94a3b8` (slate-400) | Metadata, captions |
| `--text-muted` | `#64748b` (slate-500) | Disabled text |
| `--primary` | `#6366f1` (indigo-500) | Primary buttons, links |
| `--primary-hover` | `#4f46e5` (indigo-600) | Primary button hover |
| `--primary-text` | `#ffffff` | Text on primary buttons |
| `--accent` | `#38bdf8` (sky-400) | Accent highlights |
| `--success` | `#22c55e` (green-500) | Success states |
| `--warning` | `#f59e0b` (amber-500) | Warning states |
| `--error` | `#ef4444` (red-500) | Error states |
| `--info` | `#3b82f6` (blue-500) | Informational states |

### Brand colours

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--brand-primary` | `#4f46e5` (indigo-600) | Primary brand, CTAs |
| `--brand-secondary` | `#0ea5e9` (sky-500) | Secondary brand |
| `--brand-dark` | `#4338ca` (indigo-700) | Darker brand variant |

### Gradient mesh backgrounds (behind glass)

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--mesh-light` | `radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, #e0e7ff 0%, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, #f0fdfa 0%, transparent 40%)` | Light mode mesh |
| `--mesh-dark` | `radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, #1e1b4b 0%, transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, #0f172a 0%, transparent 40%)` | Dark mode mesh |

---

## 3. Typography

| Element | Font (fa) | Font (en) | Size | Weight | Line height | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 (page title) | Vazirmatn | Inter | 2.25rem (36px) | 700 | 1.2 | Page headings |
| H2 (section) | Vazirmatn | Inter | 1.5rem (24px) | 600 | 1.33 | Section headings |
| H3 (card title) | Vazirmatn | Inter | 1.25rem (20px) | 600 | 1.4 | Card titles |
| Body | Vazirmatn | Inter | 1rem (16px) | 400 | 1.6 | Body text |
| Small / caption | Vazirmatn | Inter | 0.875rem (14px) | 400 | 1.5 | Metadata, helper text |
| XS | Vazirmatn | Inter | 0.75rem (12px) | 400 | 1.4 | Badges, timestamps |
| Button | Vazirmatn | Inter | 0.875rem (14px) | 500 | 1.4 | Button labels |
| Nav item | Vazirmatn | Inter | 0.875rem (14px) | 500 | 1.4 | Sidebar navigation |

**Font loading:** Vazirmatn self-hosted via `@font-face` (`font-display: swap`). Inter self-hosted or Google Fonts with `display=swap`. Fallback chain: `Vazirmatn, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif`.

---

## 4. Spacing Scale (4px base)

| Token | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| space-1 | 0.25rem (4px) | Tight spacing |
| space-2 | 0.5rem (8px) | Component padding |
| space-3 | 0.75rem (12px) | Small gaps |
| space-4 | 1rem (16px) | Standard gap/padding |
| space-5 | 1.25rem (20px) | Larger gaps |
| space-6 | 1.5rem (24px) | Section spacing |
| space-8 | 2rem (32px) | Large section gaps |
| space-10 | 2.5rem (40px) | Page margins |
| space-12 | 3rem (48px) | Hero/large sections |
| space-16 | 4rem (64px) | Max large spacing |

---

## 5. Radius

| Token | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| radius-sm | 0.25rem (4px) | Inputs, checkboxes, small badges |
| radius-md | 0.5rem (8px) | Glass cards, buttons |
| radius-lg | 0.75rem (12px) | Larger cards, modals |
| radius-xl | 1rem (16px) | Prominent containers, hero cards |
| radius-full | 9999px | Avatars, pills, circular badges |

---

## 6. Shadows (Glass)

| Token | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| shadow-glass-sm | `0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) inset` | Subtle glass elevation |
| shadow-glass-md | `0 8px 32px 0 rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.15), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) inset` | Glass card elevation |
| shadow-glass-lg | `0 20px 40px 0 rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.22), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) inset` | Modal/dropdown glass |
| shadow-glass-inner | `inset 0 2px 4px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)` | Inner glass highlight |

---

## 7. Component Specs (Glassmorphism)

### Glass Card
- Background: `var(--glass-bg)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`
- Border: `1px solid var(--glass-border)`
- Border-radius: `radius-lg`
- Shadow: `shadow-glass-md`
- Hover: border becomes `var(--glass-border-hover)`, bg becomes `var(--glass-bg-hover)`, translateY(-2px)

### Glass Button
- Background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.2)` light / `rgba(255,255,255,0.1)` dark
- Border: `1px solid var(--glass-border)`
- Backdrop blur: `blur(10px)`
- Text: `var(--text-primary)`
- Hover: bg opacity increases, border brightens
- Primary variant: solid `--primary` with `--primary-text`

### Glass Input
- Background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.4)` light / `rgba(255,255,255,0.15)` dark
- Border: `1px solid var(--glass-border)`
- Backdrop blur: `blur(8px)`
- Focus: border `--primary`, ring glow

### Glass Sidebar (fixed left)
- Background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.75)` light / `rgba(15,23,42,0.85)` dark
- Backdrop blur: `blur(20px)`
- Border-right: `1px solid var(--glass-border)`
- Active item: `var(--glass-bg-hover)` with left accent border `--primary`

### Glass Navbar (topbar)
- Background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.6)` light / `rgba(15,23,42,0.75)` dark
- Backdrop blur: `blur(16px)`
- Border-bottom: `1px solid var(--glass-border)`

### Glass Modal / Dialog
- Background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.85)` light / `rgba(15,23,42,0.9)` dark
- Backdrop blur: `blur(24px)`
- Border: `1px solid var(--glass-border)`
- Shadow: `shadow-glass-lg`

### Glass Badge
- Background: `rgba(0,0,0,0.05)` light / `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` dark
- Border: `1px solid var(--glass-border)`
- Backdrop blur: `blur(6px)`

---

## 8. RTL Rules

- `dir="rtl"` + `lang="fa"` for Persian; `dir="ltr"` + `lang="en"` for English
- Sidebar **stays on the left** in both directions
- Logical CSS properties (`ms-`, `me-`, `ps-`, `pe-`, `text-align: start/end`)
- Directional icons mirror (chevrons, arrows); numbers stay LTR
- Persian dates use Jalali calendar; English dates use Gregorian
- Form labels and input text align to `start` in both directions

---

## 9. Interaction States

| State | Visual treatment |
|---|---|
| Hover | Glass bg opacity lift, border brightens, translateY(-1px) |
| Focus | Brand colour ring (2px), outline-none, border `--primary` |
| Active/Selected | `--glass-bg-hover`, left border accent `--primary` |
| Disabled | `text-muted`, opacity 0.5, cursor not-allowed |
| Empty | Illustration + "No data" text + primary action button |
| Loading | Skeleton glass cards or spinner, brand colour |
| Error | `--error` border, error message text |
| Success | `--success` border/checkmark |

---

## 10. Accessibility

- Keyboard navigation on all interactive elements
- Focus visible ring on all focusable elements
- ARIA labels on icon buttons, badges, avatars
- Color contrast WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text) — verify text on glass backgrounds
- Reduced motion respected (no animation-only feedback)
- Touch targets minimum 44x44px
- `backdrop-filter` fallback: solid background for browsers without support

---

## 11. Files Referenced

- `docs/references/REFERENCES.md` — glassmorphism reference findings + component specs + RTL rules
- `docs/research/BRIEF.md` — glassmorphism research + stack validation
- `docs/references/images/` — glassmorphism screenshot references (desktop + mobile)
- `frontend/src/styles/globals.css` — glass CSS variables + Tailwind utilities
- `frontend/tailwind.config.ts` — glass theme tokens

# Implementation Plan: Rame Studio — Glassmorphism Redesign & Backend Rebuild

**Project:** rame-studio  
**Slug:** rame-studio  
**Version:** 2.0 (redesign)  
**Date:** 2026-10-27  
**Status:** Planning  
**Revision:** 1  

---

## 1. Overview

Rame Studio is a Web Design & SEO Studio Platform undergoing a complete redesign:

- **Frontend:** Full rebuild with glassmorphism UI (React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 + Antigravity UI), i18n fa (RTL default) + en (LTR) via react-i18next.
- **Backend:** Complete rebuild from scratch (.NET 10 Clean Architecture — Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api), EF Core 10 + PostgreSQL, Identity, JWT, SignalR, migrations, seed data, Stripe adapter, file storage, Swagger, sitemap/robots endpoints.
- **Docker:** Multi-stage backend + frontend Dockerfiles, docker-compose.yml, wait-for-db + entrypoint scripts.
- **Design source:** docs/design/DESIGN.md (glassmorphism tokens, palette light/dark, gradient mesh, typography Vazirmatn fa + Inter en, spacing, radius, shadows, component specs, RTL rules).
- **Research:** docs/research/BRIEF.md, docs/references/REFERENCES.md.

---

## 2. Architecture & Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Backend API | .NET 10, ASP.NET Core Minimal/API Controllers |
| Backend Architecture | Clean Architecture: Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api |
| ORM | EF Core 10 + Npgsql (PostgreSQL) |
| Auth | ASP.NET Core Identity + JWT Bearer |
| Realtime | SignalR (chat, notifications, Kanban live updates) |
| Payments | Stripe adapter (checkout, webhooks, subscriptions) |
| File Storage | Local + S3-compatible adapter (Infrastructure) |
| API Docs | Swagger / OpenAPI 3 |
| SEO | sitemap.xml + robots.txt endpoints |
| Frontend | React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 |
| UI Kit | Antigravity UI (glassmorphism-compatible) |

---

## 5. Acceptance Criteria (AC-1 through AC-42)

### AC-1 to AC-10: Backend Foundation
- **AC-1:** .NET 10 solution builds with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api projects.
- **AC-2:** EF Core 10 + PostgreSQL connection works; migrations apply cleanly.
- **AC-3:** Seed data loads (admin user, services, packages, portfolio items, blog posts).
- **AC-4:** ASP.NET Core Identity registers/authenticates users.
- **AC-5:** JWT access + refresh tokens issued and validated.
- **AC-6:** Swagger UI available at /swagger with JWT bearer auth.
- **AC-7:** /sitemap.xml returns valid XML.
- **AC-8:** /robots.txt returns valid text.
- **AC-9:** Unit tests pass for Domain + Application layers.
- **AC-10:** Integration tests pass against Testcontainers PostgreSQL.

### AC-11 to AC-20: Backend Core Features
- **AC-11:** Services CRUD API works (public list, admin create/update/delete).
- **AC-12:** Packages CRUD API works with pricing tiers.
- **AC-13:** Portfolio CRUD API works with gallery + categories.
- **AC-14:** Blog CRUD API works with categories, tags, public list.
- **AC-15:** Orders API: create, list, status transitions.
- **AC-16:** Stripe checkout session creation succeeds.
- **AC-17:** Stripe webhook updates order/payment status.
- **AC-18:** Invoices generated and downloadable.
- **AC-19:** Projects + Tasks CRUD API works.
- **AC-20:** SignalR hubs connect; chat + notification messages broadcast.

### AC-21 to AC-30: Frontend Foundation & Design System
- **AC-21:** React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind 4 app builds and runs.
- **AC-22:** Antigravity UI components render with glassmorphism tokens from DESIGN.md.
- **AC-23:** Glassmorphism CSS variables (backdrop-filter, border, gradient mesh, shadows) applied.
- **AC-24:** i18n fa (RTL default) + en (LTR) loads via react-i18next.
- **AC-25:** RTL layout correct for fa (dir="rtl", mirrored spacing, right-aligned text).
- **AC-26:** LTR layout correct for en (dir="ltr", standard alignment).
- **AC-27:** Layout shell (Shell, Sidebar, Navbar, Footer, GlassPanel, GradientMesh) renders.
- **AC-28:** Glassmorphism UI components (Card, Button, Input, Badge, Avatar, Modal, Dropdown, Table) render.
- **AC-29:** Unit tests pass for UI components.
- **AC-30:** Theme toggle (light/dark) works with glassmorphism palette.

### AC-31 to AC-40: Frontend Pages & Dashboard
- **AC-31:** Home page renders all sections with glassmorphism styling.
- **AC-32:** Services, Packages, Portfolio, About, Blog, Contact, Login pages render correctly.
- **AC-33:** Admin dashboard renders with role-based data.
- **AC-34:** Customer dashboard renders orders, projects, invoices.
- **AC-35:** Team dashboard renders tasks, kanban, chat.
- **AC-36:** Kanban board supports drag-drop with live SignalR sync.
- **AC-37:** Calendar view renders appointments/deadlines/events.
- **AC-38:** Chat renders conversation list + real-time message thread.
- **AC-39:** Role-based route guards restrict access correctly.
- **AC-40:** Browser QA passes: glassmorphism visual + RTL + all pages.

### AC-41 to AC-42: Docker & Release
- **AC-41:** Docker compose up starts backend, frontend, postgres; wait-for-db + entrypoint work.
- **AC-42:** All AC-1 through AC-40 verified and signed off.
